source.note: Captures the Doubao (Volcengine Ark) OutboundTransformer.TransformRequest mapping for a basic chat completion. The Go test constructs NewOutboundTransformer('https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3', 'test-api-key') and feeds an llm.Request{Model:'ep-20241203072800-8f7f', Messages:[{Role:'user', Content.Content:'Hello, world!'}]}. It asserts the resulting httpclient.Request has Method='POST', URL='https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/chat/completions', Content-Type='application/json', Auth.Type='bearer', Auth.APIKey='test-api-key', and that the body unmarshals to a Doubao Request whose Model, Messages[0].Role, *Messages[0].Content.Content, and Metadata==nil match the indicated values (Metadata is stripped by the transformer). Doubao uses Ark endpoint IDs (ep-...) as the model field — 'ep-20241203072800-8f7f' is a real pinned fixture literal from the Go test. selected_channel is null (no llm.Channel constructed); upstream_http and client_http are null because the Go outbound unit test does not exercise those stages.

unified_request._comment: Exact llm.Request literal the Go test feeds to TransformRequest: Model='ep-20241203072800-8f7f' (Doubao Ark endpoint ID), one user message with Content.Content='Hello, world!'.

outbound_http._comment: Asserted by TestOutboundTransformer_TransformRequest case 'valid chat completion request'. The Go validate callback checks Method, URL, Content-Type, Auth.Type='bearer', Auth.APIKey='test-api-key', and the unmarshaled Doubao Request body's Model/Messages[0]/Metadata==nil fields. The Doubao Request type embeds user_id and request_id fields (populated from llm.Request.Metadata) — both nil/empty here because Metadata is nil.

body_json._comment: Doubao-shaped Request body after TransformRequest. Only fields explicitly asserted by the Go test are populated; other Doubao-specific fields (e.g. stream, max_tokens) are not set by this minimal fixture and are omitted rather than synthesized.
